main_text.l: DE CONCORDIA MEDICORUM: AD VENCISLAUM LAVINIUM AB OTTENFELD.

TRia sunt, si bene memini, VENCISLAE LAVINI, vir præstantissime, de quibus iudicium nostrum exquiris. Primùm rogas me, ut quo pacto quis exercere se possit in Anatome Physiognomica, quam in Organo nostro esse probauimus: Deinde, quo pacto principia illa Paracelsica, Sal, Sulphur, Mercurius, ad Methodum medendi

page.notes: The first letter T is a large woodcut initial, joined to "ria" as "Tria". Long s is printed as f-like in the scan; transcribed as s. Catchword absent. Running head absent.
